### Story Point Rubric
#### Scale (number of files created or changed) n

- 0: Tiny (1 file)
- 1: Small (2–3 files)
- 2: Medium (4–5 files)
- 3: Large (6+ files)

#### Unknowns / Exploration n

- 0: Fully understood; no discovery
- 1: Minor unknowns (< 8 hours research)
- 2: Moderate discovery; proof-of-concept needed
- 3: Significant exploration; unclear path

#### Collaboration n

- 0: Solo
- 1: 1 extra person
- 3: 2–3 people
- 5: 4+ people / team coordination

#### Technical Complexity n

- 0: Straightforward; adapt existing tool
- 1: Some logic / edge cases
- 2: Complex logic
- 3: Novel algorithm

#### Risks (Impact & Probability) n

- 0: Low; Immediate need, certain widespread use
- 1: Moderate; Clear user and specific use case
- 2: High; Needed, unknowns on use case
- 3: Critical; Unknown need, unknown use cases

#### Testing Alignment n

- 0: Testing can be as is
- 1: Need to setup some tests ( < 1 hour)
- 2: Need to record videos ( < 4 hours)
- 3: Need the robot

#### Explicit Time Metric n

- 0: ≤ 2 meetings
- 1: 3 meetings
- 2: 4 meetings 
- 3: 5+ meetings

#### Story Point Mapping n SP
0–3 → 1 SP
4–5 → 2 SP
6–7 → 3 SP
8–9 → 5 SP
10–12 → 8 SP
13–15 → 13 SP
>15 → Epic (too big / ambiguous)
